closeout.summary: Pack-all landed on main. Commerce names hold tickets; Inventory packs all or none. Remaining active holds stay reserved. Pack Some and Unpack wait.

current_focus.summary: Build platform-neutral stock.pack_all: Commerce names one or more hold tickets; Inventory packs all of them in one shot or none. No order number in Inventory. Remaining holds stay reserved so the order can still be fulfilled with one-hold pack. Pack Some, Unpack, GUI, CLI, live Commerce, Woo, Katana, and deploy wait.

decisions.choice: Commerce owns the order number. Pack All names the hold IDs Commerce already has for that order. Inventory packs those tickets in one command and does not store or look up an order number.

decisions.question: How does Inventory know which holds belong to one order at Packed?
decisions.rationale: Bobby: Commerce assigns the order number at checkout. A hold ID is the ticket Inventory prints when it sets bags aside for one line. Commerce already received those tickets at reserve, so it can hand them back at Packed. Copying 1842 onto each hold is a later lookup convenience, not required to pack. Inventory stays a stock ledger.

decisions.choice: Stop. Pack nothing. The mismatch is visible. The remaining active ticket is still reserved; the order is not cancelled. Fulfillment continues with the existing one-hold pack on whatever is still active, or a later Pack Some. Refund-one-line and pack-one-line stay later mechanics. Exact same command ID retry after a full success still returns the original packed result.

decisions.question: If Pack All names two tickets and one is not an active hold, what happens?
decisions.rationale: Bobby: stop, but the order still needs fulfilled. All-or-none is so Inventory never writes hat then dies before shirt. A dead ticket means the named list does not match the shelf; packing the leftover silently would hide that. Remaining bags stay reserved until a later good pack. Commerce still owns fulfilling 1842.

decisions.choice: One or more tickets. A one-hat order uses the same Packed action. Commerce always sends the ticket list it has. Inventory does not special-case a single hold.

decisions.question: Can Pack All name a single ticket, or only two or more?
decisions.rationale: Bobby: let Pack All take one or more. Same Packed button for a one-line order and a two-bag cart. The old one-hold pack remains for later leftover fulfillment after a Pack All stop.
